name: B10-0513/2026 (The Left) – Soutien à la candidature de villes de l'Union pour accueillir un nouveau pôle des Nations unies pour l’évaluation indépendante et la gouvernance éthique de l’IA
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position. It welcomes bids from European Union cities to host a new United Nations body that would independently assess artificial intelligence and set ethical rules for it. It also calls for a binding global agreement on artificial intelligence, stronger protection of workers, limits on corporate power over artificial intelligence, and environmental safeguards. Any decision on creating such a body and where it sits belongs to the United Nations.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its position and asks for action.
- **Who it affects:** European Union cities bidding to host the body, workers, and technology companies.
- **What happens next:** Parliament asks the Council, the Commission and member states to back city bids in United Nations talks.
